name: EMWC World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: EMWC's top championship, defended by Gabriel Whitecross against the winner of a twenty-man battle royal on the promotion's own pay-per-view stage at the MGM Grand Garden in Las Vegas.

name: EMWC World Television Championship
epitaph: Held by "Precious" Pietro Sandini, who turned back a challenge from Dirt Dog Unique Allah in a Double Title Ladder Match at the MGM Grand Garden in January 1998.

name: EMWC North American Championship
epitaph: Held by Dirt Dog Unique Allah, who turned back a challenge from Pietro Sandini in a Double Title Ladder Match at the MGM Grand Garden in January 1998, despite his own tag-team partner turning on him mid-match.

name: EMWC World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by Zokugun Sangai entering the promotion's own 7 April 1999 broadcast, where The Epitome of Cool won it by pinfall.

name: EMWC Junior Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by "Righteous" Richard Blue entering the promotion's own 7 April 1999 broadcast, where Youth Gone Wild won it in a steel cage match after an outside attack left the champion unable to defend himself.
